messages:
Maya (PM): Heads up — ACME pilot flagged SSO + embeddings perf regressions. We either cut the SSO autoprompt + embedding cache or shift the pilot by 2 weeks. Need quick call on tradeoffs.
Sam (Eng): Can we quantify the perf hit? is it tail latency or median?
Maya (PM): Mostly p95 on multi-tenant embed lookups when cache misses. Customers see token cost spike and slower UX (~400ms -> 1.2s p95).
Jordan (Product Lead): Two concrete paths: 1) Cut SSO autoprompt + embedding cache for MVP (still ship core chat + generative flows). 2) Keep features, push pilot by 2 weeks and add dedicated throughput for the demo.
Olivia (Design): Cutting autoprompt means the onboarding flow loses the personalized hints. UX hit but can ship a simpler fallback CTA.
Lee (Eng-Ops): Dedicated throughput requires a Dedicated pool config + quick routing tweak. We can provision burst capacity, but SLA for demo might not be guaranteed.
Sam (Eng): Quick tech note: the embedding cache is a prefix/KV cache; hitting disk-backed buckets on miss is the culprit. We could disable cache read-on-miss and serve from model (higher token cost) but lower p95 variance.
Maya (PM): Cost impact? Customer cares about demo latency more than per-token cost for pilot.
Jordan (Product Lead): For long-term, caching is needed. For pilot, prefer predictable latency. Option 1 (cut autoprompt + disable cache reads on miss) seems lowest risk and minor UX compromise.
Lee (Eng-Ops): Operationally we can add a rollout flag: `pilot_low_latency_mode=true` that disables cache reads and turns off autoprompt enrichment. Quick deploy and revert.
Sam (Eng): I can PR the flag and a small gating check in runtime today. Need approvals for canary and smoke tests.
Olivia (Design): I'll make the fallback copy and a small banner explaining "Streamlined demo mode". No new flows.
Maya (PM): Decision: opt-in pilot_low_latency_mode for ACME demo. Ship cutoff: close PRs by EOD, canary tomorrow morning.
Jordan (Product Lead): Add action items: Sam -> PR + tests; Lee -> create rollout flag and plan canary; Olivia -> fallback UI; Maya -> inform sales and ACME PM with mitigations + timeline.
Sam (Eng): Noted. Will include perf metrics baseline and a smoke script that simulates 100 concurrent embed requests.
jenkins-bot: Build triggered: pipeline/#8472 -> test-suite (sam/embedding-cache-flag) queued
Lee (Eng-Ops): I'll schedule the canary window 09:00-11:00 PST and be on standby.
Maya (PM): I'll message ACME: "We have a demo-mode toggle to ensure consistent latency; minor UX simplification. Plan to re-enable cache after the pilot with a follow-up release."
Jordan (Product Lead): If we re-enable later, add a rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring on p95 and token cost. Create an incident alert to auto-fallback if p95 > 900ms.
Sam (Eng): Will add metrics and the fallback hook.
Maya (PM): Good. That resolves the immediate decision. Revisit permanent cache optimizations in next cycle. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Olivia (Design): Copy for the banner: "Demo mode enabled — optimized for a smooth preview. Full personalization returns after pilot." Will post in the PR.
Jordan (Product Lead): Closing note — this is a scope-surgical decision, not a product cutoff. We keep the core hypothesis for v1 intact.
Maya (PM): Filing a short follow-up doc in Notion with the decision log and owners.
jenkins-bot: Build started: pipeline/#8472 -> test-suite (sam/embedding-cache-flag) running
